title: Uwell Viscore Pink Lemonade Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Uwell Viscore Prefilled Pod & Refill in Pink Lemonade delivers a perfect balance of tangy citrus and sweet, fruity notes, providing a refreshing and satisfying vape. Designed for the Uwell Viscore 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container for extended usability and exceptional value. Equipped with a 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod is optimised for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, ensuring smooth vapour and full-bodied flavour. The refill container makes topping up effortless, extending the pod’s usability for up to 8000 puffs, depending on personal usage. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod provides a silky-smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine absorption, ideal for adult vapers seeking a reliable and flavourful vaping experience. Replace the pod and refill container when empty to continue enjoying the zesty, sweet Pink Lemonade flavour.
